_sources.notes: v0.1.0 (2026-10-25): preset, sample and wavetable tooling; its plugins mfreak-speech and mfreak-peek patch the firmware.

_limitations: microfreak-tools 0.1.0 by gbryant (Apache-2.0): preset, sample and wavetable transfer over SysEx/USB, and plugins that patch the firmware (mfreak-speech: a custom Speech-engine vocabulary; mfreak-peek). The MIDI chart is unchanged. Untested on hardware.
